Definition: Total volume of the allocortex in mm3. In the Stephan-school parcellation the allocortex is all cortical tissue that is not neocortex (isocortex): the sum of the olfactory (palaeocortical) and non-olfactory (archicortical, hippocampal) parts. Printed as 'Allocortex (total)' by Kruska 2014, as 'allocortex' by Ebinger 1974, and as 'Allocortex' in the Stephan & Pirlot 1970 lineage. Not the ventral-allocortex subfield (Va) of Kowianski 1999.
Note: Canonical term added 2026-11 with the volumes wiring (Kruska 2014, Ebinger 1974, Stephan & Pirlot 1970 own teams).

Definition: Volume of the olfactory allocortex in mm3: the palaeocortical part of the allocortex in the Stephan-school parcellation (piriform/olfactory cortex and periamygdaloid areas). Printed as 'Olfactory allocortex' by Kruska 2014 and as the olfactory allocortex column by Ebinger 1974. Together with Nonolfactory_allocortex it sums to Allocortex (total); distinct from Palaeocortex_plus_amygdala, which additionally includes the amygdala.
Note: Canonical term added 2026-11 with the volumes wiring.

Definition: Volume of the non-olfactory allocortex in mm3: the archicortical part of the allocortex in the Stephan-school parcellation (the hippocampal formation). Printed as 'Non-olfactory allocortex' by Kruska 2014 and as the non-olfactory allocortex column by Ebinger 1974. Together with Olfactory_allocortex it sums to Allocortex (total).
Note: Canonical term added 2026-11 with the volumes wiring.
